en: Distinctions Concerning the Mixing of Mind with Abhidhamma Categories
For whom wholesome consciousness arises and does not cease, will wholesome consciousness cease for them and not arise?

At the moment of arising of the final wholesome consciousness, for those [beings], wholesome consciousness arises and does not cease; it will cease and will not arise. For others, at the moment of arising of wholesome consciousness, for those...
[and so on]. Or rather, for whom...? Yes, [it is so]... [and so on].
In whom unwholesome consciousness arises and does not cease … [as before] … In whom indeterminate consciousness arises and does not cease … [as before] … (The three pairs—
*mūlayamaka*, *cittayamaka*, and *dhammayamaka*— proceed thus up to the section on the peaceful and the non-peaceful.
The Text of the *Cittayamaka* is finished.
